Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. High level response below; we'll push a concise artifact that maps to Skybridge control IDs by Monday.

Proposed evidence taxonomy (short):
1) Identity & Access proofs — IAM policies, role-to-user mapping, key rotation logs (KMS/HSM attestation).
2) Runtime telemetry & logs — inference request traces, request/response metadata, quota/ratelimit logs.
3) Configuration & change history — infra-as-code state, deployment manifests, security group rules.
4) Data handling & storage proofs — encryption at rest metadata, retention configs, access logs.
5) Operational narratives & attestations — runbooks, canary results, operator attestations.

Sampling heuristics (proposal):
- Telemetry: 7-day rolling windows for production traffic + 1% tenant random sampling for multi-tenant examples.
- Logs: 3 random business days per 90-day period + contiguous 24-hour window on incident timelines.
- Keystore/KMS proofs: latest rotation artifacts and a 90-day rotation history snapshot if requested.
- Redaction: PII removed at source; when redaction changes fidelity, we provide a redaction-log snippet.

Ingestion SLA: Our default target is 48–72 hours for static artifacts (configs, attestations). For telemetry extracts that require a custom query we can ingest within 5 business days. If you need faster turnaround for specific controls, please flag them and we will raise a scoped SLA exception.

Next steps: we'll produce a 1-page CAIQ crosswalk (control -> taxonomy bucket -> artifact example) + a sampling matrix. Priyom will add technical notes on telemetry extraction.

Jonas
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Alicia / team — quick technical clarifications to make sure the sampling is actionable for your auditors:

1) Telemetry extraction: we will provide a reproducible query + an exported CSV (schema: request_id, model, tenant_id, timestamp, latency_ms, token_counts, cache_hit) and a sample of 1% tenants across the requested window. That export will be staged to the shared drive link below.

2) Logs & retention: production inference logs have a 90-day hot retention and 2-year cold retention. For the 3-day sample we mentioned, we will include both request/response traces and KV cache metrics when relevant.

3) Redaction process: PII is redacted before persistence; we include a redaction-report artifact showing redaction rules, regexes, and a hash-map proof for originals (where permitted by contract).

4) Evidence access & portal: we can push artifacts to the Drive folder or provide temporary portal access (read-only) to your auditors. For larger exports we can share an S3 presigned URL that expires in 7 days.
